title: Enrollment
description: The one exchange in the protocol that is not signed by an already-known key, and therefore the one that decides every later trust decision. The connector generates its key pair locally and sends only the public half; the single-use token proves the request came from someone who could read the console.

token.description: Single-use, short-lived. The control plane stores only its digest and burns the row on first use, in the same transaction that records the identity.

public_key.description: Base64 of the 32 raw Ed25519 public key bytes. The private half is generated on the customer's host and has no representation in this protocol at all.

encryption_key.description: Base64 of the 32 raw X25519 public key bytes, used to seal a source configuration to this connector (ADR-034). A dedicated key rather than the signing key converted for key agreement: one key answering for two protocols fails silently when it fails. Optional, because a connector enrolled before sealed configuration existed has none and must keep working.

control_plane_public_key.description: Pinned on first enrollment. Every later job signature is checked against this key, so rotating it is a deliberate, visible operation rather than something a request can do.
